name: loom-slack
description: loom's Slack venue adapter: each agent's own Slack app, its DMs and group DMs routed to the agent and handed to loom's deliver, and the agent's replies posted as that app

loom.name: slack
loom.label: Slack
loom.description: Slack as a venue: each agent's own app; a DM or group DM is checked against Slack and the gates and delivered to the agent, and its replies post as that app.

options.label: Shadow: read slowly, route and log, deliver nothing, post nothing
Live: Socket Mode, deliver to loom, post replies

settings.name: SLACK_BOTS
settings.label: Each agent's app
settings.hint: JSON: agent to the secret holding its app's env file (SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_APP_TOKEN, SLACK_TEAM_ID, SLACK_BOT_USER_ID), like {"kit": "kit-slack.env"}; the secrets piece's policy must allow that agent

settings.name: SLACK_DATA
settings.label: Where its cursors and logs are kept

settings.name: SLACK_POLL_S
settings.label: Seconds between ticks
settings.hint: default 65 in shadow (one history read per agent a tick), 5 live

settings.name: SLACK_TOKEN_FILE
settings.label: This piece's own token, to deliver with (live)
settings.hint: a file holding a piece token of this piece's (loom token create --piece slack/<name>)

settings.name: SLACK_LOOM_URL
settings.label: loom's address, as this machine reaches it

settings.name: SLACK_GATES_COMMAND
settings.label: How an agent's gates are read
settings.hint: a JSON argv printing {"doc": …}, {agent} filled in; default the runtime's ["loom", "runtime", "gates", "people", "--agent", "{agent}", "--json"]
